page.pageDescription: Digitize your facility records by importing from Excel or scanning documents.
page.excelDescription: Import patient data from Excel or CSV files with smart column mapping and duplicate detection.
page.ocrDescription: Scan handwritten prescriptions and documents to extract patient data using AI-powered OCR.
page.bulkDescription: Import multiple entities (patients, prescriptions, doctors, lab tests, inventory) with AI-powered validation and batch processing.
page.bulkStep1: Import 5 entity types (patient, prescription, doctor, lab-test, inventory)
page.bulkStep3: Download CSV templates per entity type
page.tipsExcelBody: Make sure your file has headers in the first row. Common column names like "First Name", "Phone Number", etc. will be automatically detected.
page.tipsPhoneBody: We automatically clean and normalize phone numbers, removing country codes and formatting.
page.tipsDuplicatesBody: Patients with matching phone numbers or matching name + date of birth will be flagged duplicate and skipped.
